description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions and configurations for the OpenWrt firmware on the 'pistachio' hardware platform. It defines methods to check the image, perform upgrades, and set environment variables related to NAND flash partitions.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image is compatible with the current platform by retrieving the board name and performing a NAND platform check.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs platform-specific upgrade procedure, primarily by determining the current boot partition, setting the environment for the next boot, and executing NAND upgrade commands based on the detected board.
